title: ProBoy-MD
summary: An open-source WhatsApp Multi-Device bot written in Node.js. It ships 224 command files across 9 categories.
description: ProBoy-MD is a modular WhatsApp Multi-Device bot built with Node.js and the Baileys library.
It ships 224 command files across nine categories: general, AI, group, dev, media, fun, utility, textmaker, and admin. It uses pairing-code login and a '.' prefix.
features: Group tools, media, and AI helpers
creator: Shahan Ali

title: ProBoy CamLink
summary: Camera shortlinks with browser diagnostics, device telemetry, and capture sessions.
description: ProBoy CamLink generates browser-based diagnostic shortlinks for testing camera permissions and device capabilities.
It pairs a capture frontend with a control panel for logs and session review.
features: Session control panel and capture review
creator: Shahan Ali

title: ProBoy JS Obfuscator
summary: A client-side JavaScript obfuscator that encodes source code in your browser.
description: ProBoy JS Obfuscator encodes and obfuscates JavaScript locally in your browser. Your source never leaves your machine.
It is built for quick checks and source protection before production builds.
features: Instant output with copy and download
creator: Shahan Ali

title: ProBoy Encrypt & Decrypt
summary: AES-256-GCM encryption plus image steganography and a local vault, all in the browser.
description: ProBoy Encrypt & Decrypt encrypts text with AES-256-GCM using the Web Crypto API.
It also hides encrypted payloads inside PNG images and keeps a local vault in your browser.
creator: Shahan Ali

title: ProBoy-SiM_Database
summary: Structured lookup for simulation records and cellular activation reports.
description: ProBoy-SiM_Database is a structured portal for simulation records and activation reports.
It uses an interactive table for fast lookup and filtering, with API-backed data.
creator: Shahan Ali
